strategy.overview: Orbit and Outer Space advance a backglass spaceship once for each 100 points; every ten advances adds one Bonus step, up to 10,000. The left vari-target can add up to five advances, and the right spinner builds the same progress with a safer miss. The upper gate scores 3,000 and returns the ball to the plunger. Build Bonus with the spinner and vari-target, then use the upper gate to collect a free plunge and repeat.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Orbit and Outer Space, plunge the center Bonus-advance lane. Then shoot the right spinner or left vari-target: every 100 points moves the spaceship, and every ten moves add one Bonus step. The upper gate scores 3,000 and returns the ball to the plunger. Build Bonus toward 10,000, collect the gate, and repeat the plunge.
strategy.summary: Favor the right spinner until the left vari-target rebound proves controllable. Take the always-open upper gate for 3,000 and another plunge. Nudge a natural left-return-lane feed through the lower gate, but do not force it after an upper-gate shot closes it.

steps.text: Plunge the center Bonus-advance lane at the upper left.
From the left flipper, shoot the right spinner to build spaceship and Bonus progress.
From a settled right flipper, test the left vari-target and use it only when the rebound returns safely.
Shoot the always-open upper gate for 3,000 and a return to the plunger.
Repeat the center-lane plunge and build toward the 10,000 maximum Bonus before the end-of-ball collect.

buildsToward.title: A 10,000 Bonus and repeatable free plunges

steps.text: Use spinner and vari-target points to move the spaceship.
Convert each ten spaceship steps into one Bonus advance.
Use the upper gate to score 3,000 and restart the sequence from the plunger.

machineSetup: Identify four-player Orbit or two-player Outer Space, then confirm three- or five-ball play, last-ball Double Bonus, Special conversion, and whether the lower gate behaves as expected after the left return lane and upper gate.

Test the three upper-left lanes, spaceship stepper and every tenth-step Bonus advance, Bonus to 10,000, all vari-target depths, right spinner, upper gate and plunger return, left-return lower-gate switch, and bumper feeds around both sides.
